segments.en: Okay, so before we talk about transferable, what is the difference here? We have two words, college and university.

segments.en: Well, college and university are words that we use in English to describe higher education.

segments.en: That means education after high school.
segments.zh: 这意味着高中毕业后的教育。

segments.en: And a college is usually just for people who are in the middle of their studies.

segments.en: But a university is usually a larger institution that has bachelor's degree students as well as master's degree students and PhD candidates.

segments.en: And so while a college is for 18 to 22 year olds, a university can have students of all ages who are doing sometimes very advanced degrees like postdoctoral work.

segments.zh: 我从未听说过安姆利昂学院。

segments.en: Could you?
segments.zh: 你能帮忙吗？

segments.en: Of course, sir.
segments.zh: 当然，先生。

segments.en: Let me give you a brief overview.
segments.zh: 让我给你一个简短的概述。

segments.en: AmLion College is located in the center of New York City.
segments.zh: 安姆利恩学院位于纽约市中心。

segments.en: The school covers a wide range of academic subjects, and 80% of the courses are transferable to other state universities.
segments.zh: 学校涵盖广泛的学术科目，80%的课程可转让给其他州立大学。

segments.en: And last year, AmLion College was ranked number one in terms of graduate employment.
segments.zh: 去年，Amlion 学院在研究生就业方面排名第一。

segments.en: Interesting.
segments.zh: 有意思。

segments.en: And what about the tuition fees, then?
segments.zh: 那么学费呢？

segments.en: You'll be looking at somewhere around $15,000 per semester.
segments.zh: 每学期的学费大约是一万五千美元。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well...
And did I mention our on-campus housing?
segments.zh: 我有没有提到我们的校园住房？

segments.en: Students can stay in our newly renovated dorms for as little as $3,000 per month.
segments.zh: 学生可以在我们新装修的宿舍中以每月只需 3,000 美元的价格入住。

segments.en: Sounds good.
segments.zh: 听起来不错。

segments.en: Well, I'll just grab one of your flyers.
segments.zh: 好吧，我只会抓住你的一张传单。

segments.en: Sir, you got the wrong flyer.
segments.zh: 先生，您收到了错误的传单。

segments.en: Sir!
segments.zh: 先生！

segments.en: Sir!
segments.zh: 先生！

segments.en: All right, so universities in the United States, they have a very...
segments.zh: 好吧，所以在美国的大学，他们有一个非常...

segments.en: They have a...
segments.zh: 他们有一个...

segments.en: They're infamous for being very expensive.
segments.zh: 他们因非常昂贵而臭名昭著。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so we discussed the difference between colleges and universities, but I think it's important to also talk about the difference between public and private schools.
segments.zh: 所以我们讨论了学院和大学之间的区别，但我认为也重要的是要谈谈公立学校和私立学校之间的区别。

segments.en: Public schools are schools that are paid for by the government or that are subsidized, so the government pays part of them.
segments.zh: 公立学校是政府支付或补贴的学校，因此政府支付其中的一部分。

segments.en: And these are schools that tend to be cheaper than private schools.
segments.zh: 这些学校往往比私立学校便宜。

segments.en: So private schools can be as much as $50,000 for one year of study.
segments.zh: 因此，私立学校一年的学习费用可能高达 50,000 美元。

segments.en: So, for example, the famous ones like Harvard or Stanford, those are private schools.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，像哈佛或斯坦福这样的著名学校，那些是私立学校。

segments.en: Those are private schools, but the University of California is a public institution.
segments.zh: 这些是私立学校，但加州大学是一所公共机构。

segments.en: The University of Illinois, for example, is another public institution.
segments.zh: 例如，伊利诺伊大学是另一个公共机构。

segments.en: So there are many different options in the United States.
segments.zh: 所以美国有很多不同的选择。

segments.en: I think usually the state universities have the name of the state in them.
segments.zh: 我认为通常州立大学在其中有州的名称。

segments.en: So University of Florida is probably state university.
segments.zh: 所以佛罗里达大学可能是州立大学。

segments.en: That's right, but you have to be careful because the University of Pennsylvania is a private university.
segments.zh: 没错，但你必须小心，因为宾夕法尼亚大学是一所私立大学。

segments.en: Oh, really?
segments.zh: 哦，真的吗？

segments.en: Yeah, it's an Ivy League school, so it's one of the oldest schools in America, and it's like Harvard or Yale. It's very, very high quality.
segments.zh: 是的，这是一所常春藤盟校，所以它是美国最古老的学校之一，就像哈佛或耶鲁大学一样。 它的质量非常非常高。

segments.en: This is something that they always mention when talking about universities in the States.
segments.zh: 这是他们在谈论美国的大学时总是提到的。

segments.en: They always say it's an Ivy League school, just like you said right now.
segments.zh: 他们总是说这是一所常春藤盟校，就像你现在说的那样。

segments.en: What does it mean if a university is Ivy League?
segments.zh: 如果一所大学是常春藤盟校是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, a league is just a group, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，联盟只是一个团体，对吧？

segments.en: And so some of the first universities in the United States formed this group called the Ivy League, and I think it used to have to do with the sports.
segments.zh: 因此，美国一些第一批大学组成了这个名为常春藤联盟的团体，我认为它曾经与体育有关。

segments.en: These teams would play each other in sports, but I could be wrong.
segments.zh: 这些球队会在体育运动中互相比赛，但我可能错了。

segments.en: But anyway, in the 18th century, these were schools for men, and there were seven Ivy League schools for men, and then there were the sister schools for women.
segments.zh: 但无论如何，在 18 世纪，这些学校是男性的学校，有七所常春藤盟校，还有女子的姐妹学校。

segments.en: Wellesley, Radcliffe, these are the sister schools.
segments.zh: 韦尔斯利，拉德克利夫，这些是姐妹学校。

segments.en: And so nowadays, both men and women can go to all these universities, and so we just talk about them as the Ivy Leagues.
segments.zh: 所以现在，男人和女人都可以上所有这些大学，所以我们只是把他们称为常春藤联盟。

segments.en: And the Ivy League schools that are most famous are Harvard, Yale, Brown, University of Pennsylvania, Columbia, things like that.
segments.zh: 最著名的常春藤盟校是哈佛大学、耶鲁大学、布朗大学、宾夕法尼亚大学、哥伦比亚大学等。

segments.en: So talking about universities and colleges, I have heard also the community college.
segments.zh: 所以说到大学和学院，我也听说过社区学院。

segments.en: Yeah, that can be a lot more affordable.
segments.zh: 是的，这可以更实惠。

segments.en: That's something that's, because it's a community college, it's usually something you go to back near your home.
segments.zh: 就是这样，因为它是一所社区大学，它通常是你在家附近回去的东西。

segments.en: Because colleges and universities, sometimes people travel very, very far to go to these schools.
segments.zh: 因为学院和大学，有时人们会走得很远很远去这些学校。

segments.en: But community colleges are available to people in your own community, and you can take night classes.
segments.zh: 但是社区大学可供您自己社区的人使用，您可以参加夜间课程。

segments.en: You can do a lot of different things at them.
segments.zh: 你可以对他们做很多不同的事情。

segments.en: They're great resources.
segments.zh: 他们是很好的资源。

segments.en: They're a lot more affordable than other schools.
segments.zh: 它们比其他学校实惠得多。

segments.en: And a lot of people like to go to them because they don't have to pay these expensive fees for housing like dorms or for travel.
segments.zh: 很多人喜欢去找他们，因为他们不必为宿舍或旅行等住房支付这些昂贵的费用。

segments.en: And they're a great option for people.
segments.zh: 它们是人们的绝佳选择。

segments.en: So community colleges, colleges, and universities are the major distinctions.
segments.zh: 所以社区学院、学院和大学是主要的区别。

segments.en: There is a lot to talk about on this subject, especially if you're a student or you're a professional, considering doing a master's abroad or you want to go to the States or Canada to study.
segments.zh: 关于这个主题有很多话要说，特别是如果您是学生或专业人士，考虑在国外攻读硕士学位，或者您想去美国或加拿大学习。

segments.en: There's a lot of things to take into consideration.
segments.zh: 有很多事情需要考虑。

segments.en: So this is a great topic.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个很好的话题。

segments.en: We really want to hear from you if you have any other questions or doubts.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何其他问题或疑问，我们真的很想听听您的意见。

segments.en: You can always find us at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 您随时可以在 Englishpod.com 找到我们。

segments.en: We hope to see you guys there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到大家。

segments.en: Until next time.
segments.zh: 下次再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
